title: Pass conversation context into Agent Skill execution
goal: Keep Skill selection anchored to the current user request while passing bounded conversation and relevant-memory context to the selected Skill or Agent Team.
context: KernelSession already builds contextualInput for model inference, including recent conversation turns, relevant memory, and response-language preference. Skill and team routing previously received only normalizedStatement as their execution input, so context-dependent follow-up requests lost this information. Preserve current-request-only intent selection while forwarding contextualInput as the Skill input payload.
forbidden_changes: Do not change Skill intent-selection semantics or use conversation history to select a Skill.
Do not bypass capability policy, Agent scope, ModuleRuntime, verification, or cancellation checks.
Do not change provider/GGUF routing or add a parallel execution loop.
Do not claim CI passes before the required checks complete.
acceptance_criteria: Single-Agent Skill selection continues to use the current normalized user request.
Selected Skill input receives contextualInput when supplied, with a backward-compatible fallback to the goal statement.
Agent Team selection continues to use the current normalized user request while team Skill input receives contextualInput.
Existing callers that omit inputContext remain source-compatible.
validate-contract, Swift package tests + repository integrity, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA are checked on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm validate-contract, Swift package tests + repository integrity, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA CI gates.
recovery: Revert this single logical task commit if contextual input changes selection behavior or causes Skill execution regressions.
